title: COUNTBLANK over a text column counts the empty string as well as BLANK

source.quote: Any empty string is considered as a blank for COUNTBLANK purposes, even though ISBLANK would return FALSE for an empty string
You can use columns containing any type of data, but only blank cells are counted
source.supports: the other reading: only BLANK is counted

derivation: Empty[Txt] holds '' (Id 1), BLANK (Id 2), x (Id 3). DAX Guide says COUNTBLANK counts empty strings as blanks: rows 1 and 2, so 2.
alternative: The Microsoft page says only blank cells are counted. Read strictly, only row 2 counts and the result is 1.
